finite_semantic_model.axis_state_meaning: These are three logical combinations of two Boolean predicates with dominant=>present, not three numeric degrees or medical measurements. Dominance means that quality prevails over its contrary on its own axis; presence alone does not entail dominance.
finite_semantic_model.state_universe: S is the Cartesian product of the two axis case sets:9 abstract states. Opposite qualities are not separately named target values, and absent HEAT is not automatically a written COLD value.
finite_semantic_model.profile_universe: R is a NONEMPTY subset of S, denoting the admissible outcome states for one written regimen, recipient and time horizon. There are511 abstract profiles. No profile is asserted to be observed or actually clinically possible.

ar.denotation: P_H(s)=HEAT is present in state s

aiin.denotation: P_M(s)=MOISTURE is present in state s

finite_cases.P_H: D_H(s)=HEAT dominates its contrary in s
finite_cases.P_M: D_M(s)=MOISTURE dominates its contrary in s

d.invariant: D_H implies P_H and D_M implies P_M. No application d(NOT(P)), d(d(P)) or arbitrary unnamed state predicate is licensed.

o.type_schema: Pred(X) -> Pred(X), X restricted to exactly S or R
o.cost: Two explicit type instantiations of the same Boolean complement; not two adjustable denotations. No synonymy with qo or or.

t.law: t_ALL(P)(R)=for every s in R, P(s)
t.interpretation: The declared outcome profile guarantees that state property. It does not claim actual success, a causal mechanism or an observed outcome.

literal_derivations.otodar: o_R(t_ALL(o_S(d(P_H)))) = some admissible outcome has dominant HEAT
literal_derivations.otodaiin: o_R(t_ALL(o_S(d(P_M)))) = some admissible outcome has dominant MOISTURE

writer_contract.segments: Literal left-to-right prefixes denote right-nested function application: o t o d ar = o_R(t(o_S(d(ar)))); all characters remain, none is deleted or substituted.
writer_contract.scope: Only these9 exact full forms receive derivations. Five bounded shape licenses: base Q; dQ; odar; otQ; otodQ, Q in{ar,aiin}. No unattested whole odaiin is promoted because its internal expression occurs in otodaiin.
writer_contract.word_boundaries: Each ring form is one complete source group with definite outer spaces; no internal morpheme boundary is observed. This is an explicit segmentation hypothesis, not a diplomatic split.

design.same_owner_condition: The collision below is relevant ONLY if a complete written grammar asserts both members of a quality pair about the SAME regimen, recipient, horizon and outcome profile. Same line is not that binding. Rebinding to different patients/plans or interpreting a word as quoted/denied must be written and counted, not invented after seeing a collision.

serious_rival.name: t_SOME instead of t_ALL, keeping every other atom, constructor and segmentation fixed
serious_rival.law: t_SOME(P)(R)=some s in R has P(s)
serious_rival.distinction: A possible effect versus a guaranteed effect is a substantive regimen distinction. Neither is stated by the source or established in the target; both are predeclared interpretations of the same nested morphology.

composition_falsifier.main_ALL: Each pair otar+otodar, or otaiin+otodaiin, can both hold on one nondeterministic profile: at least one outcome lacks P and at least one has dominant P.
composition_falsifier.rival_SOME: The same pair cannot both hold on any nonempty profile, because it would require all outcomes NOT P and all outcomes D(P), while D(P) implies P.

profile: s0: neither HEAT nor MOISTURE present; neither dominates
s1: HEAT and MOISTURE both present and each dominant on its own axis
explicit_logical_witness.consequence: Under t_ALL all four ring predicates hold. Under t_SOME neither pair can jointly hold. This is a stipulated algebraic witness, not an executed test or historically verified physical outcome.

composition_falsifier.single_outcome_countercase: If every profile has exactly one outcome, t_ALL=t_SOME and both pairs are incompatible. Therefore the proposed discrimination REQUIRES more than one admissible outcome for at least one same-owner profile; changing profiles after a conflict would be a repair.
composition_falsifier.source_feasibility_countercase: The two-state witness is not source-attested. If a source-faithful complete model restricts relevant living-person outcomes so that HEAT or MOISTURE is always present, the corresponding main-pair witness can disappear. Do not invent a temperature threshold, redefine presence as excess, or add an unmentioned dead/other recipient to rescue it.
composition_falsifier.decision_gate: First complete whole-line ownership and polarity. If same-owner joint assertions are absent, this card has no collision-based discriminating capacity. If they are present but only singleton/always-present profiles are licensed, retain that conflict rather than broadening the model silently.

additional_fixed_consequences: odar is a STATE predicate NOT dominant HEAT, never an effect or a regimen. Its two .1 occurrences must take written state owners.
dar/daiin are dominance predicates; plain ar/aiin are presence predicates. Any complete reading must preserve this distinction at every occurrence.
No conclusion about NOT-HOT=COLD, quality correction, actual treatment efficacy, universal t semantics elsewhere, or target language follows.

freedom.compression_limit: Deriving9 forms from2 base values and3 constructors constrains the meanings, but adds substantial typing, segmentation, state-model and ownership assumptions. It is not a demonstrated economy or translation.

design.why_distinct: RAW556 guessed only ot as SUPPLIES over two quality nouns and left the nested ring unbound. This proposal instead types every repeated o/t/d occurrence in all four ring forms, keeps state versus regimen predicates separate, and predicts a two-input modal-scope collision. It does not extend556's denotations or repair537.
design.minimum_next_step: No solver. Attempt a full .1 argument/polarity grammar while preserving all other occurrences. Stop if the quartet cannot receive written same-owner binding or physically/epistemically admissible profile multiplicity; a whole-content author may instead preserve the precise incomplete hypothesis.

design.dominance_regimen_limit: A possible dominant quality is not automatically a desirable goal or an instruction to produce it. The source says sustained contrary-quality victory can harm. A complete hypothesis must write whether these effect predicates describe a risk, possibility, caution or intended end; it cannot silently convert the predicates into prescriptions.
